data.name: Natural Horsemanship & Basic Riding Lessons
data.headline: Ages 12+ • 1 hour • 1 on 1 lesson with one of our experienced wranglers!
data.description:
# Interested in learning how to ride? We’re happy to show you the basics of natural horsemanship and basic riding skill.

##Duration 
1 hour 

##About
Designed for beginner to intermediate riders, these lessons focus on building confidence and connection with horses through natural horsemanship. Each session includes both groundwork and riding, covering skills like approaching, catching, saddling, and effective communication with your horse. Lessons are tailored to the individual, ensuring a personalized experience based on your comfort level and prior horse or riding experience. No two lessons are exactly the same, allowing you to progress at your own pace.
data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellations/Rescheduling:
	•	Must be canceled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance.
	•	Late cancellations will incur a $30 fee.

Payment:
	•	Full payment is required at the time of booking for single lessons.
	•	Packages must be paid in full before the first lesson.

Refunds:
	•	Packages are non-refundable but may be transferred to another person.

Safety Requirements:
	•	Helmets are required and will be provided if needed.
	•	Closed-toe shoes and long pants are mandatory.

Arrivals:
	•	Please arrive 10 minutes early to ensure the full lesson time is utilized.
data.booking_notes:
##What to bring

- Please wear sturdy, closed toe shoes. Sneakers are acceptable. No sandals, flip flops or crocs. 
- Wear jeans or leggings, shorts are not comfortable for riding.
- *You are welcome to bring carrots for the horses after your lesson.*

***Sunscreen is mandatory if riding during the day.***
